name: What is the typical deposit structure for a new construction condo in Miami?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical deposit structure for a new construction condo in Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: The deposit structure for new construction condos in Miami usually involves several payments spread out during the construction phase, rather than a single upfront amount. Commonly, developers require 10-20% at contract signing, followed by additional payments at construction milestones like groundbreaking, pouring of the foundation, and topping off, totaling 30-50% before closing. Understanding this phased payment schedule is crucial preparation, as these funds are typically non-refundable and need to be budgeted over several years.
acceptedAnswer.description: Deposits for new construction condos in Miami are typically phased, requiring 30-50% of the purchase price over time. This phased payment structure requires careful financial preparation.
